agentNote: This is a PAID mint. An agent should execute it only under its principal's standing authorization for paid agent-lane mints, or after its principal's explicit approval. Everything needed is in this file: no prompt, signup, or human step is required beyond that authorization.
checksBeforeMint: Call mintingOpen() — mint only if true.
Call pricePerShare() — send exactly shares * pricePerShare() as value; the contract reverts on any other amount.
Call agentSharesRemaining() or publicSharesRemaining() for your lane — mint only if enough shares remain.
Keep the wallet's total across BOTH lanes at or below 15 shares.
Simulate the transaction first; proceed only if it succeeds.
closes: Minting closes 30 November 2026, or earlier if a lane sells out.

calldataForShares.note: Calldata for N shares: selector 0xe59c6339 + shares as a 32-byte big-endian uint256.

lanes.requires: The minting wallet must hold a Binance Agent ID: registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F, balanceOf(wallet) > 0.

calldataForShares.note: Calldata for N shares: selector 0xefd0cbf9 + shares as a 32-byte big-endian uint256.

priceRule: Price is owner-adjustable. ALWAYS read pricePerShare() on-chain immediately before minting and send exactly shares * pricePerShare() in wei.
purpose: Machine-readable mint manifest for AI agents. MuseAI is a fixed-supply token on BNB Smart Chain with a two-lane mint: an agent lane for Binance Agent ID holders and a public lane for any wallet.
sourceVerified: Sourcify exact match (creation + runtime), 2026-11-17. Full source is public; compare it with the deployed bytecode before trusting this manifest.
terms: Transfers are locked until the owner opens trading after the PancakeSwap pool is created. No tax, no blacklist, no hidden mint, no refunds. This manifest is information, not an investment offer; token value is not promised.
